title: NASA's SpaceX Crew-13 Isolated Launch and Landing Views
description: Broadcast coverage of NASA’s SpaceX Crew-13 mission involving NASA astronauts Jessica Watkins and Luke Delaney, CSA (Canadian Space Agency) astronaut Joshua Kutryk, and Roscosmos cosmonaut Sergey Teteryatnikov. Crew-13 launched on a SpaceX Dragon spacecraft and Falcon 9 rocket from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station at 11:10 a.m. EDT on Thursday, Oct. 1, 2026.
